eligibility: Exactly one publisher pole polygon, at least one publisher crossarm polygon, an elongated pole mask, unambiguous crossarm-to-axis-end association, and a non-truncated selected endpoint.
target: Visible pole-shaft axis endpoint nearest the publisher crossarm polygon(s), deterministically derived from publisher masks. This is not an annotated physical tip and not an upper-assembly box.
normalizer: Square root of publisher pole-mask area in the 1280-long-side working raster.
selection: Protocol frozen before computing model metrics; development split only; no threshold tuning and no UK accuracy claim.
model_execution: No new inference. Compares preserved outputs from Roihu jobs 910514 and 921987.
